## Description

"Offboard" on a staff member sets membership to offboarded, revokes all sessions and devices for that tenant, cancels pending invites, reassigns or flags their open items (none clinical yet in P1), and records reason and actor.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** After offboarding, the next request from any of the person's sessions in that tenant fails within 60 seconds and they cannot sign in to that tenant.
- [ ] **AC2.** Memberships in other tenants are unaffected.
- [ ] **AC3.** The action requires confirmation, a reason, and is audited.
- [ ] **AC4.** The last practice admin cannot offboard themselves (prevents lock-out).

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
